comment: F11 — the experience loop. TWO FRESH RUNS (never a branch: an alternate latent_quality.csv changes latent_quality_hash, which is a shared manifest hash, so branch would be refused and rightly so). `catalog_dir` is rewritten per arm by shopsim.eval.harness to eval/fixtures/quality-{good,bad}, which are copies of the demo catalog differing ONLY in latent_quality. Nothing the shopper can read differs: latent quality never enters a DecisionContext (Law 15), it reaches them solely as EXPERIENCED satisfaction after the fulfilment lag. Promos on and reach high so purchases — and therefore deliveries — actually happen inside 16 ticks. SIZED 2026-08-20: trust only moves through EXPERIENCED, which needs a purchase plus the 2-tick fulfilment lag, so both arms need real buyers. The x6 arrival wave is applied identically to both, so it cannot explain a divergence — the only asymmetry between the arms is latent_quality, which no shopper can read.
